entries.379b2d5d814d214f: It adopts as its VISION "Change the world, right beside that innovation," and states that it aims to provide high-quality, reliable services based on the "MEEQ Quality Charter" established in November 2025.
entries.3855418329e100b8: The fiscal year ended March 2026 was the first year of consolidated financial statements, so no prior-year comparison is printed, but the filing states that, on a basis excluding short-term LTs, contracted lines exceeded 710,000, an increase of about 42,000 from the end of the previous fiscal year. Because most revenue is monthly recurring billing based on contracted lines, the structure can be read as one in which growth in lines directly leads to expansion of the revenue base.
entries.38d2efeabe921ba0: It operates an IoT/DX platform service that provides "MEEQ," a SaaS-type IoT platform using SIMs, and an MVNE service that supports the three carriers NTT Docomo, KDDI and SoftBank, providing MVNO operators with SIM procurement, inter-operator settlement operations, service design and other services.
entries.42975e4a7e93e55f: As an MVNE provider supporting three carriers (NTT DOCOMO, KDDI and SoftBank), it provides MVNOs with SIM procurement (including negotiations with mobile network operators), operation of inter-operator settlement, service design and various other support (support for entering the new MVNO business and increasing revenue). It offers "Self-Operated MVNO", a made-to-order model that lets customers design their own plans, and, through the consolidated subsidiary MEEQ Mobile Inc., "MVNO as a Service", which handles a wide range of operations including billing, customer management and customer support. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,120 million.
entries.50d4fe23f8fb987a: The fiscal year ended March 2026 was the first year of consolidated financial statements, so no prior-year comparison is printed, but the filing states that, on a basis excluding short-term LTs, contracted lines exceeded 710,000, an increase of about 42,000 from the end of the previous fiscal year.
entries.53e7597215be43bc: The group has L2 connections with three carriers, NTT Docomo, KDDI and SoftBank, and states that it can set its own pricing schemes, including communication speed restrictions. It states that MVNE operators with L2 connections to three carriers are limited in Japan, and that entry requires three elements: telecom technical capability, knowledge of telecom business and understanding of regulations, and customer acquisition capability to recover fixed costs such as capital investment; because very few companies have all three, it states that barriers to entry are high. It also states that, through "bandwidth sharing" that combines the IoT/DX platform service, which uses a lot of upstream bandwidth, with the MVNE service, which uses a lot of downstream bandwidth, it absorbs traffic imbalances and keeps down the additional cost of securing bandwidth.
entries.68736a0933e3e298: This is the group's only business (a single segment), offering IoT/DX platform services for IoT service providers and companies promoting DX, and MVNE services that support MVNOs.
entries.6a6cdc6250e9cbc6: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥879 million.

entries.762039059fe16568: As an MVNE provider supporting three carriers (NTT DOCOMO, KDDI and SoftBank), it provides MVNOs with SIM procurement (including negotiations with mobile network operators), operation of inter-operator settlement, service design and various other support (support for entering the new MVNO business and increasing revenue).
entries.76d4012f19243c15: The company provides "MEEQ," a SaaS-type IoT platform that uses SIMs. From a Web screen, SIMs can be purchased and managed starting from 1 line, and no-code operation reduces the burden of system development. It offers "MEEQ APPS" for alive monitoring and similar functions, the "MEEQ Data Platform" for data utilization, a global SIM supporting about 180 countries and regions, and "MEEQ Business Tools Device Select," which provides one-stop service from device procurement to SIM kitting, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,030 million.

entries.c29cfed7c050e443: It adopts as its VISION "Change the world, right beside that innovation," and states that it aims to provide high-quality, reliable services based on the "MEEQ Quality Charter" established in November 2025. As its basic strategy, it states that it promotes three drivers that boost sales growth ("MVNO as a Service" to support entry by non-telecom operators; expanded business support and cross-selling of the IoT/DX platform; and industry-specific services and horizontal deployment of vertical solutions) and two pillars that accelerate growth (pursuing discontinuous growth through strategic M&A and investment; and thorough operational efficiency through AI implementation).
